description: Search Foursquare places (keyless — Pipeworx supplies the key). Combine `query` (e.g., "coffee", "hardware store") with a location anchor — either `near` ("Brooklyn, NY", "San Francisco, CA") or `latitude`+`longitude`. sort:"RATING" orders results by Foursquare rating (best first); the rating NUMBER itself is a Foursquare Premium field and is returned only where enabled — check `rating_included` / `rating_reason` in the response, and read `rating_note` before telling a caller a place is unrated. Returns name, fsq_place_id, categories, address, distance, lat/lon, tel, website.

categories.description: OPTIONAL. Comma-separated numeric fsq_category_id values ONLY (e.g. from a prior search_places result). Do NOT invent IDs or pass category names — use the `query` text for that (e.g. query:"coffee"). Unknown IDs are ignored.

name: search_places
